Question: Triangle \(ABC\) has \(\angle BAC = 60^\circ,\) \(\angle CBA \le 90^\circ,\) \(BC = 1,\) and \(AC \ge AB.\) Let \(H,\) \(I,\) and \(O\) be the orthocenter, incenter, and circumcenter of \(\triangle ABC,\) respectively. Assume that the area of the pentagon \(BCOIH\) is the maximum possible. What is \(\angle CBA?\)
